name: agent-office-vscode
description: Pixel-art office that visualizes your real Claude Code sessions, subagents and teammates. Local only, read-only.
author: JonathanClintonW

commands.title: Agent Office: Install Claude Code Hooks…
Agent Office: Remove Claude Code Hooks…

agentOffice.port.description: Loopback port of the local monitor (127.0.0.1 only).

agentOffice.autoStartMonitor.description: Start the monitor inside VS Code when no monitor is already running.

agentOffice.claudeConfigDirs.description: Additional Claude configuration directories to watch (the default ~/.claude and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR are always included).

agentOffice.showOnlyCurrentWorkspace.description: Initially show only agents whose working directory is inside this window's workspace folders.

agentOffice.nativeNotifications.description: Show VS Code notifications when an agent needs permission or input, or a turn fails.
